subject: Thanksgiving week printables (and a Christmas story starring your child)
preview: Free turkey and pumpkin pie coloring pages, plus a printable book with their name in it.
intro: Thanksgiving week is here, so this week's pages are made for keeping little hands busy while the turkey cooks. Everything below is free to print.

free.title: Thanksgiving coloring pages
free.blurb: Turkeys, pumpkin pie, a cornucopia and a Mayflower ship. Print a stack for the kids' table.

free.title: Name tracing
free.blurb: Type each guest's name and let your child trace them. It doubles as place cards.

free.title: Christmas coloring pages
free.blurb: For the weekend after, when the tree goes up: Santa, reindeer, stockings and gingerbread.

free.title: Winter coloring pages
free.blurb: Snowmen, mittens and sledding for the first cold days.

picture.alt: Line drawing of a cute round turkey with fanned tail feathers, ready to color
picture.caption: The cute turkey page is a favorite with preschoolers.

featureNote: It prints in minutes, so it works as an Advent night surprise or a Christmas Eve read-aloud.

tip.title: A 5-minute thankful page
tip.body: Before dinner, ask your child to draw one thing they are thankful for on the back of a coloring page. Write their words under the picture for them. It's a sweet keepsake and keeps them busy while the table gets set.
